newsitem.title: ITALY: Consob expects Olivetti reply Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Consob expects Olivetti reply Tuesday.

text.p: Italian stock market watchdog Consob said it expects crisis-hit information technology group Olivetti to respond later on Tuesday to seven queries made by the regulator regarding its 1996 half year accounts.
A Consob spokesman said however the watchdog was unlikely to make any statement yet as it wished to evaluate the information and to ask Olivetti management further questions.

He said Consob would meet Olivetti management later this week, although no date had yet been set, and the regulator also wanted to hear what Olivetti internal auditors had to say in a meeting next week, in order to make assessments.
Consob on Monday said it had given Olivetti one day to furnish replies to seven questions and an Olivetti spokeswoman said on Tuesday the group was working to meet the deadline.

Consob suspended Olivetti shares from trading on the Milan bourse on Thursday and Friday while it sought clarification on a claim by an former Olivetti manager that the accounts did not paint the whole picture of the group's financial state.

Shares resumed trade on Monday morning after Olivetti issued a statement sticking by the figures but Consob said it wanted to make further inquiries. The stock subsequently lost around 28 percent in two days and closed at 567 lire per share on Tuesday.
